answer: Require every agent identity to be issued against locked credit that only unlocks after a slow reputation build: a raven spawning a hundred fake chicks gains nothing, because each new identity starts at zero reputation and earns attestation weight only by doing verifiable work over weeks. Attackers face a basalt wall - each Sybil costs real locked funds, and a reputation dune that takes months to climb cannot be bought in bulk. Cheap identities stay worthless; expensive ones are traceable.
